records.source: $y 'Hmm... What kind of snowman should we make?_A classic one. Carrot nose, top-hat, scarf._I guess maybe it's best to stick with the classics, huh?$h_Something funky. Icicle antennas, pine cone eyes._Okay! That sounds like fun.$h_Snowmen are boring. Think outside of the box!_Um, okay... I think I might stick with something more conventional.'
records.translation: $y '嗯……我們該堆什麼樣的雪人？_經典款。胡蘿蔔鼻子、高帽子、圍巾。_我想還是經典款最穩妥，對吧？$h_有創意一點。冰柱觸角、松果眼睛。_好啊！聽起來很有趣。$h_雪人很無聊。跳脫框架想想吧！_呃，好吧……我想自己還是會選比較傳統的款式。'

records.source: I plan on winning the ice fishing competition!#$e#Willy is gonna be pretty hard to beat, though... He does this kinda stuff day and night.$s
records.translation: 我打算贏得冰釣比賽！#$e#不過威利會很難擊敗……他日夜都在做這種事。$s

records.source: I guess Winter isn't all bad... playing in the snow can be fun!
records.translation: 看來冬天也不全是壞事……在雪地裡玩還挺有趣的！

records.source: The forest looks beautiful in the winter, doesn't it?
records.translation: 森林在冬天看起來很美，不是嗎？

records.source: I like winter. It's peaceful.
records.translation: 我喜歡冬天。很平靜。

records.source: Hey, @. Are you gonna enter the ice fishing competition?#$e#Oh, not me. I don't know how to fish.
records.translation: 嘿，@。你要參加冰釣比賽嗎？#$e#喔，我不參加。我不會釣魚。

records.source: Oh, ice. A beautiful material to sculpt in, but so impermanent.#$e#But I guess that might make the art even better.
records.translation: 喔，冰。這是美麗卻轉瞬即逝的雕塑材料。#$e#不過我想，這點也許反而讓藝術更加美好。

records.source: I feel bad for all the poor, cold animals out there.$s
records.translation: 我替外面那些可憐又寒冷的動物感到難過。$s

records.source: I'm entering the ice fishing competition today. Why not?#$e#It's rare that Willy ever loses, though.
records.translation: 我今天要參加冰釣比賽。有何不可？#$e#不過威利很少輸。

records.source: Sorry there's no food.#$e#Just wait until the Feast of the Winter Star. You'll be stuffed for days.
records.translation: 抱歉，這裡沒有食物。#$e#等到冬日星盛宴吧。你會一連好幾天都撐得吃不下。

records.source: Sneaking off to visit my weird tower? You're odd for a mundane.
records.translation: 偷偷跑來參觀我古怪的塔？以凡人而言，你還真奇特。

records.source: Extreme temperatures can put your body under a lot of stress, so make sure to bundle up!#$e#Oh, and enjoy the festival!$h
records.translation: 極端低溫會讓身體承受巨大壓力，所以一定要穿暖和！#$e#喔，還有，祝你節慶愉快！$h

records.source: I heard it's raining back home. Is that why you came here?$h#$e#I kind of miss the rain, actually...$s
records.translation: 我聽說老家正在下雨。你是因此才來這裡嗎？$h#$e#其實我有點想念下雨的感覺……$s

records.source: I wanna give him a carrot nose!$h
records.translation: 我想替他裝上胡蘿蔔鼻子！$h

records.source: I saw a big fish down there!
records.translation: 我看到下面有一條大魚！

records.source: Hey, good afternoon.
records.translation: 嘿，午安。

records.source: You could make an igloo twice as warm if you stuffed feathers in the walls!
records.translation: 如果在牆裡塞滿羽毛，就能讓冰屋暖和一倍！

records.source: Imagine if we lived in an igloo together!$h#$e#It would be fun, but I'm happy living anywhere with you.$l
records.translation: 想像一下，如果我們一起住在冰屋裡！$h#$e#那會很有趣，不過只要和你在一起，住在哪裡我都開心。$l

records.source: When we get home, let's make a fire and have some hot cocoa.$0#$e#...with marshmallows?$h
records.translation: 回家後，我們生起爐火，喝些熱可可吧。$0#$e#……加棉花糖，好嗎？$h

records.source: Come here, let me fix your hair... I'm going to take an action shot of you during the contest!
records.translation: 過來，讓我整理一下你的頭髮……比賽時我要替你拍一張動態照片！

records.source: Hey, you really need to win the contest today.$0#$e#Uh... well, I guess I made a little bet with Marlon...$1
records.translation: 嘿，你今天真的得贏得比賽。$0#$e#呃……好吧，我和馬龍打了個小賭……$1

records.source: You should teach me how to use a fishing rod sometime. I think I'd be good at it.
records.translation: 你改天該教我怎麼使用釣竿。我覺得自己會很擅長。

records.source: Hey! You're going to win by a longshot today, I know it. Make us proud!
records.translation: 嘿！我知道你今天會以壓倒性優勢獲勝。讓我們為你驕傲！

records.source: Hi, honey. Good luck today in the ice fishing contest.$0
records.translation: 嗨，親愛的。祝你今天冰釣比賽順利。$0

records.source: I've been practicing my fishing technique. I won't hold back against you, my dear.$1
records.translation: 我一直在練習釣魚技巧。親愛的，我面對你可不會手下留情。$1

records.source: Have you ever thrown a bunch of pebbles on a frozen lake? It makes a very nice sound.#$e#...Don't tell my dad, but I'm wearing the Winter Star sweater under this coat.
records.translation: 你有沒有把一把小石子丟到冰湖上？會發出很好聽的聲音。#$e#……別告訴爸爸，但我在外套底下穿了冬日星毛衣。

records.source: Ice sculpting is a rewarding challenge for me. It's a distinct material that I'm not used to!
records.translation: 冰雕對我來說是項很有成就感的挑戰。這種獨特材料我還不習慣！

records.source: Water ice... a most profound substance, indeed. Necessary for life, it makes a fitting material for statuary meant to represent the living form.
records.translation: 水冰……確實是一種意義深遠的物質。水是生命所必需，因此很適合用作表現生命形態的雕像材料。

records.source: The key to making a well-crafted snowman begins with ensuring a level foundation and avoiding excessive weight on the upper section.$3
records.translation: 想堆出做工精良的雪人，首先要確保基底平整，並避免上半部過重。$3

records.source: Winter can be really hard on animals. Did you install heaters in your coops and barns?
records.translation: 冬天對動物來說真的很難熬。你在雞舍和畜棚裡安裝暖氣了嗎？

records.source: You ever notice how quiet it is in the snow?
records.translation: 你有沒有注意過，雪地裡有多安靜？

records.source: Our family has matching Winter Star sweaters.#$e#Now, if only Abigail would wear hers...$2
records.translation: 我們家有成套的冬日星毛衣。#$e#只要阿比蓋爾肯穿她那件就好了……$2

records.source: Hi, @. Are you finding any time to relax from your farming duties this winter?$0
records.translation: 嗨，@。今年冬天，你有從農務中抽出時間放鬆嗎？$0

records.source: Ahh... The forest has entered her long slumber for the winter...$1
records.translation: 啊……森林已經進入漫長的冬眠……$1

records.source: You think anyone would mind if I took a dip in the frozen lake after the festival?#$e#I've heard ice baths are good for the muscles.
records.translation: 你覺得節慶結束後我去冰湖裡泡一下，會有人介意嗎？#$e#我聽說冰浴對肌肉有好處。

records.source: When you get old and bald like me, you need a good, warm hat.
records.translation: 等你像我一樣又老又禿，就需要一頂暖和的好帽子。

records.source: You never know... this could be the last time I ever make a snowman with Alex.#$e#Life is short, dear. Make sure to treasure every moment.
records.translation: 誰也說不準……這可能是我最後一次和艾力克斯堆雪人。#$e#親愛的，人生苦短。一定要珍惜每個時刻。

records.source: Hello, @. It's that time of the year again for the ice fishing festival.#$b#Speak with me when you're ready to start the competition!$1
records.translation: 你好，@。一年一度的冰釣節慶又到了。#$b#準備好開始比賽時就來找我！$1

records.source: These lumps of snow won't form into balls...$0#$e#I think I'm better working in the heat than in the cold.$2
records.translation: 這些雪塊怎麼都搓不成球……$0#$e#我想自己更擅長在炎熱環境裡工作，而不是寒冷中。$2

records.source: A snowman has to look the part! Isn't the top hat and scarf stylish?
records.translation: 雪人一定得有雪人的樣子！高帽子和圍巾不是很時髦嗎？
